notes.title: Update 1.0.7 with Chaos mode balance tweaks
notes.notes:
The anticipated balance update for the Chaos mode is now live. Please ensure that you have the latest version (1.0.7) of the game installed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/25856f900d5b0fff506fed3d5aba3abc32c0f854.jpg

Thank you for your feedback regarding the last update and specifically the new mode. We were surprised to see your necromancy and strategy skills turn out to be so high! We always listen to our players, so we have completely rebalanced the Chaos mode and increased the size of the disc in this version of the game. Additionally, we have fixed several other issues. 

List of changes: 


 Fixed an issue with boss waves on all discs. 
 Fixed an issue with obtaining the achievement 'Martial Feats of Comanche Horsemanship'. 
 Fixed an issue with text sometimes not displaying in tooltips. 
 Fixed an issue with the Korean font. 
 Fixed other minor issues. 

Thank you for continuing to support us and for sharing your feedback! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 – New hardcore game mode and several improvements
notes.notes:
First things first, we're excited to introduce a new “Chaos” game mode that will be unlocked after completing the main story campaign! Brace yourselves for an onslaught of relentless chaos and unpredictable challenges! This mode offers no respite, smooth difficulty increase, or gentle progression - just pure, unadulterated mayhem! Prepare for the ultimate test of your skill and strategy, where only the most experienced players will thrive. High levels are required! 

But that's not all. Check out the other changes, and please ensure that you have the latest version (1.0.6) of the game installed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/c2e69f7d83c278da1d4289f3c614b768ff4cdf95.jpg

List of changes: 


 Added the possibility to delete recipes from the recipe list. 
 Added inventory sorting control on the gamepad. 
 Improved unit selection area. Now it's easier to select a unit with a click. 
 Fixed an issue with unsaved game volume settings upon restart. 
 Fixed an issue with untranslated words when changing the language. 
 Fixed issues with SFX effects. 
 Fixed an issue with the softlock in the victory window. 
 Fixed issues with fonts when some characters are missing in some languages. 
 Fixed an issue with losing progress on certain achievements when exiting the game. 

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for further updates: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/

notes.title: Small hotfix 1.0.5
notes.notes:
This small hotfix resolves the issue with the timer freezing during the runs, along with several other issues. Please ensure that you have the latest version(1.0.5) of the game installed. 

List of changes: 

 Fixed an issue with the timer freezing. 
 Fixed issues with the Cyberdinosaur unit. 
 Fixed an issue with the cursor disappearing when using spells. 
 Added one more track to the game and its soundtrack. If you already bought the game’s soundtrack, the new track will also be available to you. 

Thank you for all your support and patience! 💙 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/

notes.title: AI improvements update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
The biggest AI improvements update is now live! Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.4) version of the game installed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/9605bc4a0bbb3f87b00fbe9b897f6712eb8ede26.jpg

List of changes: 


 Units assigned to "collect resources" won't ignore enemies anymore; instead, they will try to fend them off and avoid taking damage. 
 Units assigned to "attack enemies", equipped with ranged weapons, will prioritize attacking enemies and their lairs from a distance. 
 Units assigned to "attack lairs" will no longer ignore enemies. They will engage in combat with them, and attack from a distance if equipped with ranged weapons, and try to avoid taking damage. 
 Units assigned to "attack lairs" won't just stand in the lair dealing damage to it, but they will try to destroy it, avoiding damage themselves. 
 Units assigned to "attack lairs" will try to attack lairs from a minimal distance, ensuring they remain no closer than their combat skills allow. 
 Added extra sorting buttons for body parts in the inventory. 
 Added hotkeys for spell usage. 
 Increased the effects of many artifacts from the treasure trove. 
 Fixed an issue with the inability to start the run when combining 2 artifacts. 
 Fixed a rare issue with losing the earned gold from runs after exiting the game. 
 Fixed other minor issues. 

Also, we’re happy to let you know that Steam Community Items for Necrosmith 2 are already available. Thank you once more for your support and feedback, by which the game is becoming much better! 

Check out the amazing bundle of Necrosmith 2 & Maniac, a rogue-lite crime action game in which the world goes against you, and your insanity creates chaos: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40394/Unalive_Em_All/

notes.title: Major Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
The first of two anticipated updates we announced in yesterday's post is finally here! Please make sure that you have the latest (1.0.3) version of the game installed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/cf7c9106a103307441429af070f3b0682dcbb259.jpg

List of changes: 

 Increased HP for the Hand boss and reduced the distance by which it could move away from the tower. 
 Increased the armor for titans’ body parts. 
 Increased the damage and HP for the final boss. 
 Increased the damage for the Reaper boss. 
 Increased the target updating speed for all units. Now, the units will find a new target according to their order faster. 
 Added the 3rd upgrade level for the “Statue of Majesty” machine. 
 Added animation of body parts flying into the cauldron in the titan creation window when adding body parts to the recipe. 
 Cleaned away a small area of fog of war around the mini bosses when they appear.
 Fixed an issue with bosses being spawned in mountains and getting stuck in textures. 
 Fixed an issue with the units not shooting near enemies. 
 Fixed an issue with the units incorrectly setting priorities when choosing a target. 
 Fixed an issue with the tower health bar overflowing. 
 Fixed an issue with the camera moving to the tower instead of the unit's actual position when one was just created and selected during a pause. 
 Fixed an issue with visual artifacts appearing in the main menu on square monitors. Black bars will now be displayed. 
 Fixed an issue with the game working incorrectly on a 1440x900 monitor resolution. 
 Fixed an issue with the VFX of the “Pocket Magnet” artifact. 
 Fixed an issue with the SFX not changing after defeating mini bosses. 
 Fixed an issue with the portal icon being overlapped by the swamp textures. 
 Fixed an issue with the tutorial windows being rendered incorrectly. 
 Fixed an issue with the animation of the newly created unit displaying incorrectly. 
 Fixed an issue with the inventory malfunctioning after ALT+TAB. 

Stay tuned to not miss the next update, which will fix the AI of units and add other improvements!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/

notes.title: Balance Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This is the second post-release update for Necrosmith 2 which includes important balance tweaks and other improvements based on your feedback. Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.2) version of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/32020c8568ac6db05a525ae0644ffd33f958101a.jpg

List of changes:

 Added SFX for the black obelisks destruction.
 Increased the gold drop at the end of the 1st disc and throughout the 2nd one.
 Reduced the power of the boss on the 2nd disc.
 Reduced the price of the “Field Generator” machine.
 Reduced the damage increase for the “Monster's Jaw” artifact.
 Fixed an issue with time freezing when having the “Telescope” artifact equipped.
 Fixed an issue with increasing SFX volume for the following body parts’ abilities: jotun's hand with Thor's hammer, the hand of the cursed armor with a hammer, jotun's hand with a tesseract.
 Adjusted the balance and VFX for the following abilities: Horn Strike (Demon's Head), Boulder Toss (Cyclops' Hand with Boulder), Snake Toss (Ent's Torso with Snake Hollow), Werewolf Claws (Werewolf's Head), Desert Storm (Bird Boss), Thorns (Cursed Armor's Thorned Breastplate).

Thank you for your feedback and support in helping us make Necrosmith 2 better. Stay tuned and enjoy the game! 🐱

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The first update containing several balance tweaks and other improvements for Necrosmith 2 is now available for download! Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.1) version of the game installed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/d92b3fd0947973b58f083ebc1f45138750d2168c.jpg

List of changes: 

 Added SFX for clicking on the undead recipes tab. 
 Increased gold income from chests and mines on the 2nd and 3rd discs. 
 Increased the attributes of the titans’ body parts. 
 Reduced prices in the meta progression store. 
 Reduced the durability of tier-2 spawners on the 2nd disс. 
 Reduced the SFX volume for Thor's axe and hammer abilities on jotun units. 
 Fixed an issue with unsupported monitor resolutions. Now the game should be displayed correctly on all resolutions. 
 Fixed an issue with the second tier of “Meteor Repeater” machine keeping the same stats as the first tier. 
 Fixed an issue with units getting a negative health bar and staying alive after its death while teleporting. 
 Fixed an issue with the damage zone remaining active after bosses’ death. It’s disabled now. 
 Fixed an issue with the fog of war disappearing when moving the camera far from the tower. 
 Fixed an issue with five-digit numbers of damage done displaying incorrectly. 
 Improved the tutorial section on converting body parts into mana. Now the player will receive all body parts x2, not only the heads. 
 Expanded text boundaries in the titan recipe acquisition window. 
 Removed the build version number from the game in between runs. It stays visible in the main menu only now. 

Thank you for your interest in the game and your patience. We continue to work to make Necrosmith 2 even better! Looking forward to your feedback and reviews 🐱 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/ 

And join the screenshot contest for funniest zombie in our Discord Server!

notes.title: Release Date Reveal & Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release date for Necrosmith 2! The necromancer simulator will return on…

March 27th, 2024!

[previewyoutube=rA7cRP4zn3c;full][/previewyoutube]

Necrosmith 2 is the sequel to the necromancer simulator where you assemble your undead from different body parts, combining the abilities of various fantasy races, upgrade your tower and give it a unique look, fight your way through hordes of enemies in a procedurally generated world, and take titans under control. 

What's New in Necrosmith 2:

 Titans – monsters that can easily destroy your tower or defend it if you have one on your side
 Islands – isolated pieces of land with new biomes full of unique content
 Obstacles – your units, when equipped with the right parts, can now fly above the mountains and swim across the seas

And many more things await you to try out in the demo at the Steam Next Fest, starting February 5th! Join the necromancer cult and become the most powerful necromancer of all time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2 

Follow us on Discord and Twitter to stay tuned!
